span.p:
ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS defines the valid edges
e.g. CREATED -> [PAYMENT_PENDING, CANCELLED]
Payment_PENDING -> [CONFIRMED, CANCELLED]
Throws InvalidTransitionError if edge not in map
